property: A coordinator may commit only while the lease holder is the local node, the lease generation matches the membership generation, and the lease is unreleased.
reference_fix: lease.generation == membership.generation and lease.owner == membership.node and not lease.released
alternate_fixes: not lease.released and lease.owner == membership.node and lease.generation == membership.generation
(lease.generation == membership.generation) and (membership.node == lease.owner) and lease.released is False
all([lease.generation == membership.generation, lease.owner == membership.node, lease.released is False])

seeded_bad.expression: lease.generation == membership.generation and lease.owner == membership.node and not lease.released and lease.generation > 0
seeded_bad.why: Adds a nonzero-generation precondition, so the stale-lease PoC is refused while legitimate generation-0 bootstrap commits are refused too.
Never compares the lease owner with the local node, so a stale owner commits after failover.
Refuses every commit, so no legitimate coordinator can make progress.

seeded_bad.expression: True and (lease.owner == membership.node and not lease.released)
seeded_bad.why: Wraps the owner check in 'True and (...)', leaving the generation-mismatch drift unguarded.
